detail.longDescription: Hey HN! It's Ved, the founder of Merget. Merget is a GitHub App that connects to your code repositories and autonomously manages your PR queue using deep static analysis. We can detect overlapping semantic relationships, order your queue in the most optimal order, and resolve merge conflicts in parallel across all of your PRs, ensuring your tests and CI continue to pass. In short, you can advance main by dozens of PRs with a single click, safely :) We hope to ease the burden of code produced by agentic workloads and save dev teams time and tokens! It's free to try.
